brief: Marketing landing page for "Nubo", an e-invoicing SaaS for small businesses. Sections in this order: hero (headline, subheadline and call-to-action button), features (6 cards with a title and text), pricing (3 plans: Basic, Pro and Enterprise, each with a monthly price, a list of benefits and a button; the Pro plan highlighted; a monthly/yearly toggle that applies a 20% discount to the yearly price), FAQ (6 questions that expand and collapse) and a contact form (name, email and message; live validation: name not empty, email contains @, message of 10 characters or more; Send button disabled while invalid; on submit it shows "Thanks, we'll be in touch soon"). A single view with <meta seo>. Accessible (SPEC §8) and using only the available tokens.

SaaS panel "Nubo Admin" for managing customers. Layout: navigation sidebar (Customers, Invoices, Settings; Customers active), top bar with the title and a "New customer" button, a row of 4 KPIs (total customers, active customers, billed this month and average ticket, all derived from the data), a CRUD table of customers (name, email, plan and status) with a text filter by name or email and a filter by plan, edit and delete per row, and a create/edit form (name, email and plan; validation: name not empty, email contains @). Customers come from a typed api() contract backed by an in-memory mock (§15 data with contract), so it can later be replaced by a real API../lib/api.js` (list, create, update, remove; all async). Required states: loading while saving or deleting (button disabled and labeled "Saving…"), error with a message and a Retry button, and a distinct empty state for "no customers" and "no results for the filter". One view with <meta seo>. Accessible (SPEC §8) and using only the available tokens.
